items.headline: Oracle shares fall nearly 9% as CoreWeave bond scare spreads; Oracle 5y CDS hits record ~288 bps
items.note: Record Oracle CDS widening shows CoreWeave distress contagion into a hyperscaler-adjacent investment-grade AI borrower.

items.headline: CoreWeave bonds trade at distressed levels, yields near 15%; CDS reportedly ~1,000-1,200 bps
items.note: Bonds near 77 cents on the dollar signal the market pricing meaningful default risk for the largest neocloud borrower, though no default or downgrade has occurred.

items.headline: CoreWeave's debt stress tests private credit's AI financing boom
items.note: Concentrated counterparty exposure (Microsoft, OpenAI, Meta) makes private-credit AI lending vulnerable if neocloud refinancing tightens.
